title: CSA STAR Level 1
note: The Cloud Controls Matrix v4.1's 207 control identifiers, with short titles written by this project, mapped onto the control library through CSA's own mappings of CCM v4.0.13 to the AICPA Trust Services Criteria (SOC 2), ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and NIST CSF 2.0 (CSA's ISO/IEC 27002 citations read as the ISO/IEC 27001 Annex A controls of the same number, a privacy series heading such as P4.0 as that series' criteria, and a malformed NIST CSF citation read as the subcategory it spells, such as RS-MA-01 as RS.MA-01), control-level references first and management-system clauses only where none exist. CSA has not yet published v4.1's own mappings, so each v4.1 control carries the mapping of its v4.0.13 predecessor: the control with the same identifier, or the one CSA's CAIQ v4.0.3 to v4.1 change analysis names where v4.1 renumbered it (the IVS domain became I&S); a control new in v4.1 has no predecessor and no mapping. CSA's text is not included: its licence permits only personal, non-commercial use without modification or redistribution, so read the matrix at the source. There is no certification at Level 1: an organization self-assesses and signs its own attestation. Filing the CAIQ with CSA's STAR Registry is the organization's own act, taking the same positions. A control no mapping resolves to the library maps to none, so the organization states its position on it (or maps a control of its own).
